content.title: SKF 6301 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 12mm Bore x 37mm OD x 12mm Width, ABEC-1/P0
content.short_description: SKF 6301 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 12 mm bore, 37 mm OD, and 12 mm width. Dynamic load rating 7.65 kN, static load rating 3.45 kN, ABEC-1/P0 precision class.
content.long_description:
The SKF 6301 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing in an open configuration, meaning no integral seals or shields are fitted to either side. Bore diameter is 12 mm, outer diameter is 37 mm, and overall width is 12 mm, matching standard 6301-series envelope dimensions for direct replacement in existing housings.

Load ratings are 7.65 kN dynamic (C) and 3.45 kN static (C0), figures used to calculate expected service life under radial and combined loading conditions per standard bearing life equations. The bearing is manufactured to ABEC-1/P0 precision class, the baseline tolerance grade for general industrial rotating equipment applications.

As an open bearing, the 6301 requires the end user to supply and maintain lubrication, since there is no factory-sealed grease or shield to retain lubricant or exclude contaminants. This configuration is typically selected when external sealing is provided by the housing design or when re-lubrication access is required during service.
